messages:
olivia: Quick sync — we need to lock launch criteria for Enterprise BYOK + audit logs for next week's partner demo. What are must-haves vs nice-to-haves?
marcus_pm: Must-haves: KMS integration (BYOK) that can rotate keys w/out downtime, tamper-evident audit logs, and ability to export logs to customer SIEM. Nice-to-haves: per-tenant retention policies, UI for key rotation.
aish_sec: Agree. From security POV we also need key usage audit events (who/what requested decrypt), and proof that keys never leave HSM/KMS. For MVP we can support AWS KMS + GCP KMS; other providers later.
sara_compliance: For SOC2 readiness, auditors expect immutable audit trails and 12 months retention minimum for enterprise customers. Also need exportable CSV/NDJSON for legal hold.
ben_infra: On the infra side, BYOK implies we need a secure handshake + key reference model. Proposal: customer uploads key ARN/ID, we store only key reference, ops never see key material. Implemented as: `kms_provider: aws|gcp`, `key_ref: arn:...`
ryan_sre: Ops question — if a customer revokes a key, what should behavior be? Fail-hard (reject requests) or fallback to Redwood-managed keys? We should define policy per contract. For demo we can show both behaviors as toggles. @marcus_pm thoughts?
marcus_pm: Good Q. For launch MVP let's make default = fail-hard, and allow opt-in automatic fallback in Dedicated plans only. That keeps liability clear. Document in SLA.
olivia: Audit log retention — customers asked for customizable retention windows. Do we commit to exposing retention policy in UI for launch?
sara_compliance: MVP: expose three retention tiers: 90d, 1y, 7y (enterprise). Backend must support export and legal-hold freeze. UI controls can be follow-up, but API + export must exist at launch.
aish_sec: Need to add masking controls for logs (redact PII) and ensure logs containing plaintext user payloads are not stored by default. Add opt-in verbose logging only after explicit consent.
ben_infra: Technical note — implement prefix-based KV caching so audit log events can be batched and shipped to S3/GCS with write-once objects to keep immutability. Example retention config we can accept: ```json
{ "tenant_id": "t-123", "audit_sink": "s3://redwood-audit/customer-audit-123/", "retention_days": 365, "kms_provider": "aws", "key_ref": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd" }
```
marcus_pm: Nice. For partner demo I want a checklist: 1) BYOK handshake UI flow (mock if not full) 2) Audit export to S3/GCS 3) Retention policy = 1y 4) Demo showing fail-hard when key revoked. Anything else?
ryan_sre: Add: smoke test that verifies no plaintext prompt bodies in logs for PII-sensitive customers. Can be automated.
sara_compliance: I'll draft adoption notes for SOC2 control mapping and required evidence (audit exports, key metadata, rotation logs).
olivia: Great. Prioritization: we treat BYOK + audit export + 1y retention + fail-hard as launch must-haves. Per-tenant UI, multi-provider KMS, and 7y retention are stretch.
marcus_pm: I'll update the product spec and create two PRDs: MVP and Stretch. Assigning owners: BYOK = ben+ryan, Audit export & retention = ben+sara, Compliance evidence = sara+aish.
compliance-bot: Reminder: create ticket in compliance-tracker for SOC2 evidence collection (#C-4521).
olivia: Thanks everyone — I'll sync this into roadmap doc and prep slides for demo. :thumbsup:
marcus_pm: @olivia ping me when slides are ready, I'll add the SLA bullets. :eyes:
